blocks.content: TabPFN-3.5 achieved an RMSE of 4.12k$ on holdout test set (56.4% reduction from naive mean baseline of 9.45k$). R² is 0.812. 92% of actuals fell inside the 80% prediction interval, verifying good probabilistic calibration.
